purpose: Machine-readable list of known forbidden placement methods, prohibited ObjectIDs, and contextual traps.

CUBEWALL_SPACE.reason: Invisible / zero-bbox placeholder; exclude from normal builds.

PIPE.reason: PIPE can be invisible/zero-bbox in Blender while valid in game; validate as contextual connector.

BASE_BUBPIPE.reason: BUBPIPE Blender visual/orientation can differ from in-game connected result.

BASE_FLAG.reason: BASE_FLAG is the base-claim flag: limited to exactly ONE per base and required to claim the base. It is not a design/decoration part.
BASE_FLAG.guidance: Use a non-flag tip (CORNERPOST/S_LARGETRYE0 spike) or SET_CLASS_B beam for roof crowns. Never repeat BASE_FLAG.

LIGHT_FIXTURE_RECOLOR_DOES_NOT_RECOLOR_E.required_method: select a color-responsive emitter, fixed color variant, or validated ObjectID color variant
LIGHT_FIXTURE_RECOLOR_DOES_NOT_RECOLOR_E.reason: User in-game study shows most fixture recolors alter the body/tint only; emitted light generally does not change.

SWARM_TROPHY_G.reason: Buildable via JSON/game-file/modded path and visible in game, but Blender plugin shows cube proxy and no FBX/verified extraction geometry exists.

SWARM_TROPHY_B.reason: Buildable via JSON/game-file/modded path and visible in game, but Blender plugin shows cube proxy and no FBX/verified extraction geometry exists.

SWARM_TROPHY_R.reason: Buildable via JSON/game-file/modded path and visible in game, but Blender plugin shows cube proxy and no FBX/verified extraction geometry exists.

B_SHL_D.reason: B_SHL_D appears in user JSON and is a motion/effect part, but active verified extraction and dimensions baselines did not include it.

BEAM_AS_FORM_NOT_STRUCTURE.reason: Colored beams can create apparent cones/spires, but this is visual/effect geometry only and may clash with non-sci-fi architecture.

retractions.claim: powerlines break |At|=1 with At as a non-unit run vector
retractions.reason: observed only via Blender, whose connector representation is unreliable; not a trustworthy convention. Finding #11 (At=unit, scale=|Up|) stands for RIGID PLACED parts only and is NOT extended to connectors.

FLYING_BUTTRESS.reason: No validated flying-buttress recipe exists. gothic_castle_v02 used S_RAMP as buttresses, which reads as side-stairs, not structure. Until a recipe is validated, express buttress READ via wall offsets, pilasters, and arches; if a true buttress is required, mark REVIEW_REQUIRED and request user/in-game validation.
